about: scratch-refs --check lists every scratch path form in the staged copy of every staged file, binary and deleted files left out, renames read under the new name, and a git step that fails or a missing --check never reads as clean. Run: mutate-on-target.py TREE scratch-refs.py tests/test_scratch_refs.py tests/mutants/jpt-scratch-on-scratch-refs.json

mutants.name: $HOME not a scratch root
mutants.target: each form: FINDINGS, its line listed, no lookalike

mutants.name: a path ending at the word is not one
mutants.target: each form: FINDINGS, its line listed, no lookalike

mutants.name: any word starting scratch is one
mutants.target: each form: FINDINGS, its line listed, no lookalike

mutants.name: found exits OK
edits: return jpexit.FINDINGS if found else jpexit.OK
mutants.target: each form: FINDINGS, its line listed, no lookalike

mutants.name: a binary file is read
mutants.target: a binary file is not read

mutants.name: deleted files are read
mutants.target: a deleted file is not read

mutants.name: renames not read
mutants.target: a renamed file is read under its new name

mutants.name: the working copy is read
mutants.target: the staged copy is what is read: fixed only in the working tree, still refused

mutants.name: a failed git step reads as its empty output
mutants.target: a git step that fails: NOT_RUN, naming it, never clean

mutants.name: a git failure exits OK
edits:
nothing was checked", file=sys.stderr)
        return jpexit.NOT_RUN

nothing was checked", file=sys.stderr)
        return jpexit.OK
mutants.target: a git step that fails: NOT_RUN, naming it, never clean

mutants.name: outside a repository exits OK
edits:
not in a git repository", file=sys.stderr)
        return jpexit.NOT_RUN

not in a git repository", file=sys.stderr)
        return jpexit.OK
mutants.target: not a repository: NOT_RUN, said on stderr

mutants.name: no --check exits OK
edits: return jpexit.OK if {"-h", "--help"} & set(sys.argv[1:]) else jpexit.NOT_RUN
mutants.target: no --check: NOT_RUN and the usage, never a silent OK
